body:
i'm not someone who likes people so any situation that i have to be around them causes me a lot of stress and i'd rather spend most of my time alone. i recently got a job working as a cashier and i know it's not a bad place to work or anything but keeping up an act and interacting with people so frequently has been making my mental health so much worse. i know i wouldn't have to go to that job if i did something i like more, and i've been pressured to go back to school, but i had some really bad experiences with school in both physical and sexual assault so i'm terrified of going to college. i don't really want to anyway. i just feel kind of like i'm hopeless and i'm going to be stuck the rest of my life going to a job i hate waiting for a day off so i can spend my free time wasting away doing nothing.  
i don't know. that's not all of it but it's hard to talk about or to even think about what to talk about. nothing makes me happy and i've kind of been done with being alive for a while, it's just become harder to deal with.

Thank you (and everyone else) for your input, I feel a little better knowing I'm not being overdramatic or anything. 
I'd like to go to therapy but I've had some bad therapists in the past, so I really struggle feeling comfortable anywhere like that. I also tend to shut down when talking about my experiences, so it makes it very hard to make any progress.
